qa_pairs.question: Where is the Washer Fluid Level Switch located?
qa_pairs.answer: Behind RH headlight, on windshield washer fluid reservoir.

qa_pairs.question: Where is connector C103 located?
qa_pairs.answer: Below LH side of dash, on body electrical bracket.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find connector C130?
qa_pairs.answer: Behind RH side of dash, in harness, above glove box.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the Water Shut-Off Solenoid located?
Where is connector C204 positioned?
qa_pairs.answer: Below LH side of dash, RH side of steering column.
